scientific_question: Does the excessive neural symbolic-distance slope arise from the stable-omission evidence model, neural over-sharpening, or a missing human local/conjunctive component?
claim_boundary: This is a two-seed mechanism diagnostic on frozen pilot checkpoints, not a formal confirmation gate and not evidence for a new architecture.
positive_evidence_backbone: human-scale individuality under stable subject-specific omission

field_contract.edge_order: all unordered item pairs in lexicographic integer order
field_contract.sign: positive means the first item is preferred as higher
field_contract.human_choice_preference: 2 * observed pair choice probability - 1, reconstructed from ten trials per pair
field_contract.exact_posterior_preference: 2 * P(i ranks higher than j | realized support evidence) - 1
field_contract.hodge_decomposition: orthogonal complete-graph projection F_ij = (s_i - s_j) + c_ij
field_contract.group_estimand: decompose the cohort-mean field; bootstrap subjects before taking each cohort mean
field_contract.human_sampling_boundary: primary cross-source inference uses the 77-subject cohort mean so finite ten-trial pair noise is averaged rather than mistaken for individual conjunctive code

directional_diagnosis.confidence_rule: the registered 95% bootstrap difference interval must exclude zero in the stated direction
directional_diagnosis.evidence_model_contribution: lower bound of exact_posterior minus human total_accuracy_slope is greater than zero
directional_diagnosis.neural_over_sharpening: lower bound of neural minus exact_posterior total_accuracy_slope is greater than zero
human_mixed_code_signal: lower bound of neural minus human gradient_energy_fraction is greater than zero
lower bound of human minus neural learned_correctness_aligned_residual_accuracy_effect_adjusted_for_symbolic_distance is greater than zero
directional_diagnosis.non_equivalence_rule: failure to exclude zero is unresolved and must not be described as equivalence

reporting.negative_results: retain and use to select the next mechanism test

next_test_logic.evidence_model_only: test magnitude compression and evidence uncertainty without changing the frozen pilot baseline
next_test_logic.neural_over_sharpening_only: test learned-prior or neural readout/dynamics explanations
next_test_logic.human_mixed_code_signal: test whether an emergent or explicit local relational trace complements global assembly
next_test_logic.unresolved: proceed to intermediate-fast-weight trajectory and leave-one-relation-out analyses before architecture changes
